links.outcome: Expert-rated humanistic care (needs attention, emotional support, ethics) of LLM HIV consultation answers
links.effect: Humanistic care was the weakest dimension across all four LLMs; the best model, Claude, scored a mean of 2.855 on the 5-point scale.
links.quote: It is important to note that performance varied across tasks, and humanistic care remained a consistent weak point across all models.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline capabilities of four commercial LLMs on a 23-question HIV question bank evaluated by expert raters across multiple dimensions, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
